sentences.en: In 1483-5486 Giuliano della Rovere (nephew of Pope Sixtus IV., and afterwards himself Pope Julius II.) caused the castle to be erected by Baccio Pontelli, a little to the east of the ancient city.

sentences.en: This deed, however, was viewed with far different feelings in Paris and by the partisans of the League, the murderer being regarded as a martyr and extolled by Pope Sixtus V., while even his canonization was discussed.

sentences.en: Deacon of the pope (St) Sixtus (Xystus) II., he was called upon by the judge to bring forth the treasures of the church which had been committed to his keeping.

sentences.en: Sixtus prophesied that Lawrence would follow him in three days.

sentences.en: The worc nepotism acquired new significance in the reigns of Sixtus IV and Innocent VIII.

sentences.en: In 1472 Regiomontanus was summoned to Rome by Pope Sixtus IV.

sentences.en: Mirandola so convinced Pope Sixtus of the paramount importance of the Kabbalah as an auxiliary to Christianity that his holiness exerted himself to have Kabbalistic writings translated into Latin for the use of divinity students.
sentences.vi: Mirandola thuyết phục Giáo hoàng Sixtus về tầm quan trọng tối cao của chữ Kabbalah như một thứ phụ trợ cho Cơ đốc giáo đến nỗi sự thánh thiện của ông đã cố gắng để các tác phẩm Kabbalistic được dịch sang tiếng Latinh để các học sinh thần thánh sử dụng.
